summary.what_this_is: Direct mechanism test of the spike 4 rule-based checker on seeded values. Not a live LLM run.
summary.scope_note: These are SEEDED values, not naturally-occurring model errors. This measures the mechanism, not the phenomenon. Recall on natural silent failures remains unmeasured -- spike 4's live n=3 run produced zero natural failures to measure it on.
summary.supersedes: The prose-only record of this test in risk-register.md R10 and AI_Usage_Log.md, which had no committed code or output artifact.
